description: Planned bus schedules of the Société de transport de Salaberry-de-Valleyfield (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Service offer from the Société de transport de Salaberry-de-Valleyfield in GTFS format. This format gives the position of the stops, the description of the transport lines as well as the arrival and departure times for each trip. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Bus stop, Bus, Bus, GTFS, STSV. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
